0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers come in at 5-1, first in the Northwest and third in the West, with a 4-0 road record and a two-game winning streak, while the Suns are 1-4, 12th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Pacific after three straight losses. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, and the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 series 1-2. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), and Jordan Goodwin (calf) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
